entity.description:
He has always been a controversial figure in the public eye due to LexCorp's corrupt business dealings, but he has also maintained political popularity. He has been a member of the Injustice Gang, the Injustice League, the Legion of Doom, Secret Six, the Secret Society of Super-Villains, the Justice League, and Project 7734.

Lex Luthor was created by Jerry Siegel and Joe Shuster and has had a lengthy publication history, first appearing in (1940).
